主要内容: Broadway Financial Corp (US) disclosed executive compensation details for 2011, including salaries, option awards, and other compensation. Paul C. Hudson, Chief Executive Officer, received $520,091 in total compensation. Wayne-Kent A. Brad, Chief Operating Officer, received $246,589. Samuel Sarpong, Chief Financial Officer, received $194,384. Wilbur McKesson, Chief Lending Officer, received $196,591. The data includes deferred compensation and option awards, with details on vesting and term conditions. The company also reported a 30-year loan with an initial fixed interest rate of 8% for the first five years, followed by a variable rate of 2.50% over the one-year Treasury Bill rate. As of March 31, 2012, the outstanding balance was $435,703. The company reported audit fees for 2011 and 2010, with total fees of $198,000 and $172,000 respectively. The Audit Committee preapproved all audit and audit-related services provided by Crowe Horwath LLP for the years ended December 31, 2011 and 2010.
